checkpoint_finding.interpretation: Conditionally eligible for an open champion claim. The checkpoint date alone cannot prove cleanliness because it follows the sealed source's public date by one day; eligibility rests on the paper's explicit exclusion of human genetic variation and functional genomics from training.

known_incidents_and_biases: Human reference sequence was exposed even though human variation and functional labels were not.
The paper reports modest regulatory-QTL zero-shot performance and stronger specialist sequence-to-function baselines; model scale does not imply regulatory superiority.
Autoregressive likelihood is directional and must be averaged with reverse complements over matched bases.
The official checkpoint is a 13.77 GB PyTorch .pt object and cannot be trusted as data before restricted inspection.
The source dependency vtx>=1.1.0 is not an immutable inference revision, and the 7B FP8-to-bfloat16 fallback changes runtime configuration.
One-million-base context is not feasible by declaration alone and may exceed single-L40S activation memory or throughput limits.
